name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a 4px focus ring with a 2px offset to every interactive element that gets keyboard focus. This keeps the ring visible without shrinking touch targets or cluttering small screens. The trade-off is slightly less visual prominence than a 3px ring, but it avoids overlap with adjacent elements on mobile.

name: Reader
text: Risk: A 4px ring with 2px offset still risks failing 4.5:1 contrast on dark backgrounds. Better alternative: Use a 3px ring with 3px offset—it meets contrast, stays visible at 1.25x zoom, and avoids shrinking touch targets. Settle it with a quick contrast check in the design system’s dark theme.
